title: A theme-named block on another theme renders styled in that theme: the Network island becomes a contract skin for every family

source.ref: Theme cohesion sweep (docs/THEME-COHESION.md, ADR-1923). Owner picks 2026-10-29: role blocks and manifest, phased; no live site changes on its own.

detail: Generalise NETWORK_BLOCK_CSS. Foreign-theme coverage for every family at or above 0.9 in the audit (was 0.04 to 0.25). Published sites change only where a block was already unstyled; no styled block moves.

verify.note: Reads the wiring this row ships; fails on main. The behaviour is pinned by the row's own tests.
